blocks.text: Penicillin bactericidal (bacteria ko maarne wali) antibiotics ka aik group hai jo Penicillium fungi (phaphoond) se hasil hota hai. Yeh bacteria ki cell wall banne (synthesis) ko rok kar mukhtalif bacterial infections ka ilaaj karta hai. Ise Alexander Fleming ne 1928 mein daryaft kiya. Yeh gram-positive bacteria ke khilaf bohat mo'assar hai, jin mein streptococcal aur staphylococcal infections shamil hain. Penicillin ke aam side effects matli (nausea), ulti (vomiting), dast (diarrhea), pait dard aur jild par daane (skin rashes) hain.

blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 23.1 mein penicillin ka target 'Cell membrane' chhapa hai, lekin kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke penicillin bacterial cell wall banna rokti hai (peptidoglycan ke jor); is liye yahan sahih 'Cell wall' likha hai. Figure mein 'Flurinolones' likha hai; sahih naam 'Fluoroquinolones' hai, jaisa kitab ki list mein hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Har column aik antibiotic ki kahani hai: kis ne daryaft ki (Discovery), kahan se aati hai (Source), kis bimari mein kaam aati hai (Reaction) aur bacteria ke kis hisse ko nishana banati hai (Targets). Fluoroquinolones ke saath 'Cinchona tree' is liye likha hai ke yeh chloroquine (quinine) ki tayyari se nikle aur quinine Cinchona ki chhaal se aati hai.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Penicillin bacteria ko maarne ke liye yeh tareeqa apnati hai:

items: Bacteria ko nishana banana: penicillin sirf bacteria par asar karti hai, kyunke janwaron (aur insanon) ke cells mein woh cell wall hoti hi nahi jis par yeh dawa asar karti hai.
Cell wall ko rokna: yeh peptidoglycan (murein) ki zanjeeron ke aapas mein jurne (cross-linking) ko rok deti hai, is liye bacteria nayi cell wall nahi bana pate.
Bacterial cell ka phatna: kamzor cell wall cell ki shakal aur mazbooti qaim nahi rakh sakti aur cell phat jata hai (lysis). Is liye penicillin bacteria ko sirf rokti nahi, maar deti hai.
Resistance (muzahimat): kuch bacteria beta-lactamases jaise khaas enzymes bana kar apna bachao karte hain; yeh enzymes penicillin ko tor dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin insani cells ko nuqsan kyun nahi deti?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacterial cell wall (peptidoglycan) ke banne par asar karti hai, aur insani (janwaron ke) cells mein cell wall nahi hoti.

items: Penicillin: Penicillium se, Fleming 1928; bactericidal; gram-positive bacteria ke khilaf behtareen.
Peptidoglycan ke cross-links rok kar cell wall kamzor karti hai, cell phat jata hai (lysis).
Beta-lactamases bacteria ko resistance dete hain.
